The text you provided appears to be in cuneiform script, specifically in the Akkadian language, which was used in ancient Mesopotamia (modern-day Iraq). The symbols and signs you see are logograms and syllabograms from the cuneiform writing system.

Given the complexity and the specific signs used, it is difficult to determine who exactly wrote this text or when without further context. Cuneiform texts can date back to the third millennium BCE, with the earliest known examples from the Sumerians, and continued to be used by various cultures including the Babylonians and Assyrians until the late first millennium BCE.

To identify the author and the exact date of the text, we would need more context such as the specific content, the archaeological context where it was found, and any other metadata that might be associated with the artifact or document.
